newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mercedes 9-mth sales over 57 bln DM - chmn.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes 9-mth sales over 57 bln DM - chmn.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz estimates nine-month sales were at least 57 billion marks, up around 9.5 percent from the same period of 1995, chairman Helmut Werner said on Monday.

"Overall, Mercedes-Benz's business volume in the first nine months should amount to over 57 billion marks, a year-on-year increase of approximately 9.5 percent," he told a news conference on the eve of the Paris car show.
"Our income is thus progresssing continuously, as we had announced it would," he said.
Werner told the same news conference nine-month unit sales of cars had gained 12 percent to 479,000 cars.
